record.paper_title: Some open problems in mutual stationarity involving inner model theory: a commentary.
record.context_brief: Conjectured lower bound from the stationary-set pattern in Question 3
record.original_question: Let A ⊆ ω be as in Question 3, and let S_A = {X ∈ [ℵ_ω]^{ω_1} | for every m > 1, cf(sup(X ∩ ω_m)) = ω when m ∈ A and cf(sup(X ∩ ω_m)) = ω_1 when m ∉ A}. If S_A is stationary for a single such A, must there exist an inner model with a strong cardinal?

evidence.quote: If A ⊆ ω, then let us define: SA =df { X ∈ [ℵω]ω1 | ∀m > 1 cf(sup(X ∩ ωm)) = ω if m ∈ A ω1 if m 6∈ A }.
Conjecture: If for a single A as in Question 3, SA is stationary, then there is an inner model with a strong cardinal.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Work in ZFC. For an ordinal $\lambda$ and a cardinal $\kappa < \lambda$, let $[\lambda]^{\kappa} = \{X \subseteq \lambda : |X| = \kappa\}$. A set $\mathcal{S} \subseteq [\lambda]^{\kappa}$ is called stationary if for every function $F : [\lambda]^{<\omega} \to \lambda$ there exists $X \in \mathcal{S}$ with $X$ closed under $F$.

Fix the cardinal $\aleph_\omega$ and consider $[\aleph_\omega]^{\omega_1}$. For each subset $A \subseteq \omega$, define
$$S_A = \Big\{ X \in [\aleph_\omega]^{\omega_1} \;\Big|\; \text{for every integer } m > 1,\ \operatorname{cf}(\sup(X \cap \omega_m)) = \begin{cases} \omega & \text{if } m \in A, \\ \omega_1 & \text{if } m \notin A. \end{cases} \Big\}.$$

Assume that both $A$ and $\omega \setminus A$ are infinite (so that the cofinality pattern is genuinely "divergent" in the sense that both cofinalities $\omega$ and $\omega_1$ occur for infinitely many indices $m$).

Question: If there exists at least one such $A \subseteq \omega$ for which $S_A$ is stationary in $[\aleph_\omega]^{\omega_1}$, must there exist an inner model of ZFC containing a strong cardinal?
artifact.category_tag: mutual stationarity and inner model theory
artifact.status_search_result: The conjecture appears to remain open. Related work by Adolf, Cox, and Welch obtains lower bounds for mutual stationarity with divergent cofinalities, showing for instance that certain mutual stationarity hypotheses imply the existence of sharps for inner models with a strong cardinal (e.g., via Jónsson cardinal arguments), but these results do not establish the precise conjecture as stated for the stationarity of a single S_A.

status_evidence.title: Lower consistency bounds for mutual stationarity with divergent cofinalities and limited covering
status_evidence.snippet: if κ is a Jónsson cardinal with κ < ℵ_κ then the sharp for a model with a strong cardinal exists
status_evidence.claim: Related lower bounds toward strong cardinals from mutual stationarity with divergent cofinalities have been obtained, but the precise single-A conjecture is not established.

status_evidence.title: Global Square and Mutual Stationarity at the Aleph_n
status_evidence.snippet: Mutual stationarity properties on the ℵ_n constitute large cardinal hypotheses.
status_evidence.claim: General mutual stationarity hypotheses on the ℵ_n have substantial consistency strength, supporting that the conjecture concerns deep inner-model lower bounds.
